description: This Java source file is an implementation of a service class, 'BulkImportWorkbookServiceImpl', that handles the import of spreadsheet (Excel) files into a system, including file type detection, document management, and event publication for batch processing of imports. It also includes methods for retrieving import history and output templates.

classes.name: BulkImportWorkbookServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for handling bulk import of Excel workbooks, including file processing, document management, event publishing, and retrieval of import data and output templates.

methods.name: importWorkbook
methods.description: Handles the import process of an Excel workbook based on entity type, including file type detection, reading the Excel file, and publishing an import event.

methods.name: publishEvent
methods.description: Creates a document entry, saves import metadata, and publishes an event to trigger bulk import processing.

methods.name: getImports
methods.description: Retrieves a list of recent import records filtered by entity type.

methods.name: getOutputTemplateLocation
methods.description: Fetches the storage location details of the output template for a given import document ID.

methods.name: getOutputTemplate
methods.description: Provides the output template as a downloadable Excel file for a specific import document ID.
